```yaml
name: Agentic Diagnostics

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  diagnostics:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: go.sum

      - name: Install Go dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: go test ./...

      - name: Run Go vet
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v3
        with:
          version: v1.57.2
          args: --timeout=5m

      - name: Set up Node.js for schema validation
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install AJV CLI
        run: npm install -g ajv-cli

      - name: Validate Safe Inputs JSON schema
        run: |
          # Compile the schema to ensure it is valid
          ajv compile -s docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json
```
